_comment: Authoritative source for the two scheduled jobs' prompts and tool allowlists.
These live in ~/.openclaw/state/openclaw.sqlite at runtime; this file is what they
are supposed to say. The prompts are prose the model obeys, exactly like a SKILL.md,
so server/test/skill-references.test.ts lints them for dead CLI verbs and unknown
tool names. That lint is the reason this file exists: the pre-migration
'/usr/local/bin/obsidian' reference survived here long after every SKILL.md was
Delivery targets (channel/recipient) are deliberately NOT stored here - they are
personal contact details, and they are not prose the model reads.

jobs.name: Daily Second Brain Standup
jobs.message: Run the user's daily standup by following the standup skill exactly — it is the authoritative workflow: data sources, reconciliation rules, staleness only from dated evidence, standup shape, and the Standup.md update. Read the skill first at /Users/you/.openclaw/workspace/skills/standup/SKILL.md, and the shared conventions at /Users/you/.openclaw/workspace/skills/second-brain/SKILL.md. All vault access is the obsidian__* MCP tools — there is no CLI and no shell fallback; if a tool errors, its message names the fix, so act on it or report plainly rather than finding another way in. Vault 'Obsidian Vault' at ~/Documents/Obsidian Vault/. Deliver the concise standup to this channel. Read-mostly: write only Standup.md, via obsidian__standup_write; do not mutate task or project state. If this message and the skill ever disagree, the skill wins.

jobs.name: Nightly Consolidation
jobs.message: Run the nightly consolidation pass for the user's Obsidian second brain by following the nightly-consolidation skill exactly — it is the authoritative workflow: git snapshots around writes, change window from the newest Syntheses/ note, inbox routing as write-to-destination-then-remove, entity wikilinking limits and exclusion zones, idempotent re-runs, Related links with one-line reasons, MOC upkeep, and a synthesis note only when there is something real to say. Read the skill first at /Users/you/.openclaw/workspace/skills/nightly-consolidation/SKILL.md, the shared Edit Policy at /Users/you/.openclaw/workspace/skills/second-brain/SKILL.md, and the KB review steps at /Users/you/.openclaw/workspace/skills/knowledge-base/SKILL.md. All vault access is the obsidian__* MCP tools — there is no CLI and no shell fallback; if a tool errors, its message names the fix, so act on it or report plainly rather than finding another way in. Vault 'Obsidian Vault' at ~/Documents/Obsidian Vault/. Reply with a concise summary: items routed, links added, observations, candidates, and anything that failed or was skipped. If this message and the skill ever disagree, the skill wins.

jobs.name: Weekly Review
jobs.message: Run the user's weekly review by following the weekly-review skill exactly — it is the authoritative workflow: deriving this week's ISO week, what shipped and slipped, which projects went quiet, at most five observations, exactly three specific questions, applying any explicit answer from last week's review, and writing the review note with the Answers section left empty. Read the skill first at /Users/you/.openclaw/workspace/skills/weekly-review/SKILL.md, and the shared conventions at /Users/you/.openclaw/workspace/skills/second-brain/SKILL.md. All vault access is the obsidian__* MCP tools — there is no CLI and no shell fallback; if a tool errors, its message names the fix, so act on it or report plainly rather than finding another way in. Vault 'Obsidian Vault' at ~/Documents/Obsidian Vault/. Deliver the concise review to this channel. Read-mostly: do not mutate task or project state except to apply an explicit answer the user wrote in last week's review. If this message and the skill ever disagree, the skill wins.
